description: Audio Database ACOUSTIC ARTS AMPHORA ¥ 260,000 (1 unit, around 1991) Commentary Non-directional speaker system using ceramic deflector. AMPHA means an acupressure point with both handles made in the ancient Greek period. It features a 20 cm cone woofer in the low range, a 12 cm cone mid-range in the middle range and a 2.5 cm dome tweeter in the high range. Each unit is mounted horizontally and is surrounded by a ceramic deflector in the center for sound reproduction. There are 2 variations of the appearance, black and white.
